topic: Verify a voucher on your phone after syncing
facts: Use company, financial year, voucher type and number together; compare date, party and amount against TallyPrime.

topic: Review a customer ledger before sharing a month-end statement
facts: Check customer and period, agree opening and closing balances against TallyPrime, then check the exported PDF.
Use the Windows accounting PC, connect the chosen company, then spot-check a known voucher and a known party in Syncora.

topic: Find a missing company after sign-in
facts: Confirm the dashboard account and company, then check which company was open during the most recent connector run.

topic: Find vouchers near a financial year boundary
facts: Use a synthetic March and April example to explain why an entry can be outside the selected date range or financial year.

topic: Choose the date range for a ledger PDF
facts: Use an illustrative period and explain why the opening position differs when the start date changes. Verify against TallyPrime.

topic: Spot-check a synced stock item on mobile
facts: Find a known item by name and compare the displayed item information and sync time before relying on that data.

topic: Find the correct customer or supplier ledger
facts: Use two synthetic customer names to show why selecting the exact company and ledger matters. Do not use real customer data.

topic: Decide when to use Syncora on Android or web
facts: Explain which PC runs the Windows connector and what someone can review in the synced Android or browser dashboard.

topic: Prepare a client review with synced vouchers
facts: Outline how to agree a reporting period, compare sample vouchers to TallyPrime and log discrepancies before sharing findings.

topic: Check an edited Tally voucher after the next sync
facts: Use one illustrative voucher, record its identifying details, then verify the edit after a successful connector run.

topic: Report a missing voucher with enough detail
facts: Prepare a support note with version, company, dates, voucher type and number, exact error, and redacted screenshots.

topic: Compare a selected day in the Tally Day Book
facts: Check identical company and period, compare the voucher list first, and investigate differing totals using matching voucher details.

topic: Check the latest ledger entry before following up on a balance
facts: Compare the ledger period and a recent receipt or credit note against the original books before following up with a customer.

topic: Check the Windows connector after an interrupted sync
facts: Check what the connector reported, note when it last succeeded, check the intended company, and compare a known transaction after it succeeds.
